More than a pool

We create the setting for a lifetime of memories.

40+Years of craftsmanship
A legacy that keeps moving forward

Experience in every detail. Care in every step.

Since 1980, Calypso Pools has helped South Florida homeowners turn their outdoor spaces into something personal. What began as a family-run business has grown through craftsmanship, integrity and relationships built one backyard at a time.

Today, the team combines decades of hands-on experience with thoughtful design, clear guidance and a customer-first approach—so the journey feels as considered as the finished pool.

Questions, answered

A little clarity goes a long way.

Planning a pool is a big decision. Here are answers to the questions homeowners often ask before getting started.

Ask us directly
Search a question · Tap to reveal the answer
Start with a conversation about your backyard, the look you love, how you plan to use the space and your preferred timing. The team uses that first discussion to understand your goals and guide the next steps. Call (305) 262-1424 to begin.
A survey helps capture property dimensions, city easements and construction access. Don’t have one? Calypso’s published process says its Project Surveyor can arrange a visit to collect the necessary details.
Yes. The design consultation is intended to understand your outdoor style and preferences. Calypso’s in-house engineers prepare a preliminary pool design, then the team can refine it with your feedback before final approval.
Calypso’s stated process includes a permitting team that manages submissions to your city’s building department. Once permits are approved, project supervisors coordinate the construction schedule.
Every property and design is different. The overall schedule can be affected by design decisions, permitting, inspections, site conditions, weather and the scope of work. Calypso will be able to discuss a project-specific timeline once the details are understood.
Calypso says its proposal team provides a detailed breakdown of the quote, outlining each component so you can make informed decisions about the features and how the project fits your needs.
Calypso’s website describes flexible financing through established financing partners and says most applications are pre-approved within 48 hours. Availability, terms and final approval depend on the financing provider, so ask the team for current details.
The office is at 13460 NW 107th Ave #4, Hialeah Gardens, FL 33018. The company builds pools across South Florida. Call ahead to arrange a visit or discuss whether your property is within the team’s current service area.
Call the team at (305) 262-1424 or (305) 262-1428, or use the contact details below to get started.
